blueprint_concepts: Foot of perpendicular and image of a point in a line
Image of a circle in a line

concept_use.Foot of perpendicular and image of a poi: The image of the centre C(2,4) in the line mx - y = 0 is found with the foot-of-perpendicular / image formula.
concept_use.Image of a circle in a line: The image circle S_m has the same radius 2 sqrt 2 and centre C'; its tangency to the x-axis gives |y_C'| = 2 sqrt 2.

english: Let $S$ be the circle $x^2+y^2-4x-8y+12=0$. For a real number $m$, let $S_m$ be the image of $S$ in the line $y=mx$. Then the sum of all real values of $m$ for which $S_m$ touches the $x$-axis is ______.
hindi: माना $S$ वृत्त $x^2+y^2-4x-8y+12=0$ है। एक वास्तविक संख्या $m$ के लिए, माना $S_m$ रेखा $y=mx$ में $S$ का प्रतिबिम्ब है। तब $m$ के उन सभी वास्तविक मानों का योग, जिनके लिए $S_m$, $x$-अक्ष को स्पर्श करता है, ______ है।
solution: $S$: centre $C(2,4)$, $r=\sqrt{4+16-12}=2\sqrt2$; $S_m$ has radius $2\sqrt2$ and centre $C'$ = image of $C$ in $mx-y=0$
$+$: $(4-2\sqrt2)m^2+4m-(4+2\sqrt2)=0$; $-$: $(4+2\sqrt2)m^2+4m-(4-2\sqrt2)=0$; each has product of roots $<0$, so two real roots each (four lines)
solution_full: $S$ has centre $C(2,4)$ and radius $r=\sqrt{2^2+4^2-12}=2\sqrt2$. Reflection preserves radii, so $S_m$ is the circle of radius $2\sqrt2$ whose centre $C'$ is the image of $C$ in the line $mx-y=0$.
$S_m$ touches the $x$-axis exactly when the distance of $C'$ from the $x$-axis equals the radius: $\left|\dfrac{4m^2+4m-4}{m^2+1}\right|=2\sqrt2$.

Case $+$: $4m^2+4m-4=2\sqrt2(m^2+1)\Rightarrow(4-2\sqrt2)m^2+4m-(4+2\sqrt2)=0$. The product of the roots is $-\dfrac{4+2\sqrt2}{4-2\sqrt2}<0$, so there are two distinct real roots; their sum is $-\dfrac{4}{4-2\sqrt2}$.

Case $-$: $4m^2+4m-4=-2\sqrt2(m^2+1)\Rightarrow(4+2\sqrt2)m^2+4m-(4-2\sqrt2)=0$. The product of the roots is $-\dfrac{4-2\sqrt2}{4+2\sqrt2}<0$, so again two real roots; their sum is $-\dfrac{4}{4+2\sqrt2}$.
The two quadratics have no common root (a common root would satisfy $4m^2+4m-4=0$ and $m^2+1=0$ together). So there are four values of $m$.
originality_note: New: the mirror line is a variable line through the origin, and the condition is on the image circle (tangency to an axis), giving two quadratics in the slope whose roots must all be collected (way 3; the product of all four slopes is 1 for any radius, a hidden invariant). Closest known: 'image of a given circle in a given line'. Different because: the mirror is unknown, the condition splits into a +/- case, and Vieta's sums are combined.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, curve and symbol is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical brute-force check), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. The family is y = mx (the vertical line x = 0 is not included; its image centre (-2,4) does not give tangency anyway). Checked that all four roots are real and distinct. Changed: No change.
key_step: Image of the centre in y = mx, then |y'| = r splits into two quadratics whose root sums are added.
justification: Image formula, tangency condition and a two-case Vieta sum with surds; precision matters and there are no options. Comparable to the L3 coordinate chains such as 2021-P1-Q1.
